sloka: जाम्बवन्तं तथोक्त्वा तु वृद्धं ब्रह्मसुतं तथा ।मैन्दं च द्विविदं चैव पञ्च जाम्बवता सह ।यावत्कलिश्च सम्प्राप्तस्तावज्जीवत सर्वदा ।। ७.१०८.३७ ॥
transliteration: jāmbavantaṁ tathoktvā tu vṛddhaṁ brahmasutaṁ tathā ।maindaṁ ca dvividaṁ caiva pañca jāmbavatā saha ।yāvatkaliśca samprāptastāvajjīvata sarvadā ।। 7.108.37 ॥

translations.english: Having thus spoken to the aged Jambavan, the son of Brahma, and also to Mainda and Dvivida, making a total of five including Jambavan.
